title: Qwen 3.8 Max, Mystery Model OX Alpha & 3 More AI Stories This Week

snippet.description:
Five AI stories from this week, in 55 seconds:

1. Alibaba ships Qwen3.8-Max — the largest open-weight release ever: 2.4 trillion parameters, 1M-token window.
2. A mystery model "OX Alpha" appeared on OpenRouter and beat GPT-5.6 on coding benchmarks (80% DeepSWE). Nobody knows who built it.
3. Google ships Gemini 3.7 Flash just three weeks after 3.6 — better code generation at half the price.
4. Meta returns to open weights with Muse Glimmer 30B — fully open under Apache 2.0.
5. NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Lightning runs AI agents up to 4x faster on ~3B active parameters.

Sources:
Alibaba / Tongyi Lab (via Local AI Zone roundup) — https://local-ai-zone.github.io/blog/ai-updates-august-2026.html
OpenRouter listing (OX Alpha) — https://openrouter.ai/
Google (Gemini 3.7 Flash) — https://local-ai-zone.github.io/blog/ai-updates-august-2026.html
Meta Superintelligence Labs (Muse Glimmer 30B) — https://local-ai-zone.github.io/blog/ai-updates-august-2026.html
NVIDIA (Nemotron 3.5 Lightning) — https://local-ai-zone.github.io/blog/ai-updates-august-2026.html
